# netskope_aig_mcp_server (Data Source)

Manages a custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in the Netskope AI Gateway. Custom MCP servers allow AIG appliances to proxy MCP traffic to external tool/resource endpoints for AI agent workflows.

Only custom servers (name starts with `mcp-cust-`) can be created/updated/deleted. Predefined servers are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_mcp_server" "my_aigmcpserver" {
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the MCP server.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Hostname of the MCP server backend.
- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server.
- `path` (String) URL path prefix for MCP requests.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the MCP server backend.
- `prompts` (List of String) List of MCP prompt names allowed through this server.
- `protocol` (String) Connection protocol to the MCP backend.
- `resources` (List of String) List of MCP resource URIs allowed through this server.
- `schema` (String) MCP transport schema.
- `tools` (List of String) List of MCP tool names allowed through this server.
- `type` (String) Server type. Always "custom" for user-managed servers.
